# watchpoint_rum_site (Resource)

A Real User Monitoring (RUM) site. The generated public key is embedded in the customer's snippet; rotating it (out of band) breaks deployed snippets.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "watchpoint_rum_site" "example" {
  name           = "Marketing site"
  primary_origin = "https://example.com"
  sample_rate    = 1.0
}

# Heatmaps behind a login. The screenshot capture renders the page itself, so
# without credentials a gated page is captured as its login screen. Only the
# vault KEY is stored on the site; the password stays in the vault.
resource "watchpoint_vault_secret" "app_screenshot_password" {
  key   = "RUM_SCREENSHOT_PASSWORD"
  value = var.rum_screenshot_password
}

resource "watchpoint_rum_site" "app" {
  name           = "Customer app"
  primary_origin = "https://app.example.com"

  heatmaps_enabled                   = true
  screenshot_auth_username           = "rum-capture"
  screenshot_auth_password_vault_key = watchpoint_vault_secret.app_screenshot_password.key
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Human-readable site name.
- `primary_origin` (String) Primary site origin (absolute http(s) URL). Normalized to scheme + authority server-side.

### Optional

- `additional_origins` (String) Comma-separated additional allowed origins (stored as a CSV string).
- `heatmaps_enabled` (Boolean) Whether heatmap capture is enabled.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the site is collecting. Defaults to `true` on create.
- `pii_mask_selectors` (String) Comma-separated CSS selectors whose content is masked (stored as a CSV string).
- `replay_enabled` (Boolean) Whether session replay is enabled.
- `replay_sample_rate` (Number) Session-replay sampling rate in [0,1].
- `resource_timing_sample_rate` (Number) Resource-timing sampling rate in [0,1]. Defaults to `0.1`.
- `sample_rate` (Number) Page-view sampling rate in [0,1]. Defaults to `1.0`.
- `screenshot_auth_password_vault_key` (String) Key of the `watchpoint_vault_secret` holding the screenshot basic-auth password. Only the key is stored on the site; the password itself stays in the vault and is resolved at capture time. Removing it from configuration clears it.
- `screenshot_auth_username` (String) Basic-auth username the heatmap screenshot capture uses to reach pages behind a login. Set it together with `screenshot_auth_password_vault_key`; without both, capture requests go out unauthenticated and a gated page renders as its login screen. Removing it from configuration clears it.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) RUM site ID.
- `install_snippet` (String) Ready-to-paste <script> install snippet (contains the public key).
- `public_key` (String) Server-generated public key embedded in the install snippet.
- `updated_at` (String) Last-updated timestamp (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_rum_site.example site_001
```
